meta.notes: Paths are relative to public/ and can be passed straight to the Phaser loader. Background layers are full 1920x1080 canvases: stack each variant from order 0 (back) to the last (front) at the same position. Composite is the flattened preview. Character frames are trimmed rects, not a uniform grid; register them with texture.add and play animations with origin (0.5, 1). repeat -1 loops, repeat 0 plays once.
